WPSS No. 95 of 2023
WPMS No. 909 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. B.S. Negi, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. B.D. Bisen, Brief Holder for the 
State.
Mr. M.S. Bhandari, Advocate for the 
respondent no.5.
The petitioner was appointed as 
Anganwadi Sahayika. Her appointment 
was cancelled subsequent to the 
cancellation of her BPL Card.
Today, learned State counsel would 
give a statement that, in fact, the BPL 
Card was issued by the incompetent 
authority, therefore, it was cancelled. 
Subsequent thereto, the appointment of 
the petitioner as Anganwadi Sahayika
has been cancelled.
Learned counsel for the respondent 
no.5 gives a statement that, in fact, the 
husband of the petitioner is working as 
an Accountant Rail Vikas Nigam 
Gauchar.
When the Court posed a query to 
learned counsel for the petitioner as to 
whether it is true that her husband is 
working at a place as suggested by 
learned counsel for the respondent no.5, 
he seeks time to get instructions.
List on 07.06.2023 after fresh 
cases.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 06.06.2023
Jitendra
